game_title: Trace Table Race – Chapel Gardens Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in The Kingdom – Chapel Gardens, the chapel gardens: the herald must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Trace Table Race: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program.
theme: The Kingdom – Chapel Gardens: the chapel gardens
core_gameplay_loop: In Chapel Gardens, repeat each round: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the herald ahead. Then check the trace_rows_correct value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the castle gate by solving code steps involving trace_rows_correct that move the herald forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.65).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the castle gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Trace Table Race
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Trace Table Race' (Week 1 slot 14), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Chapel Gardens'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_rows_correct changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Chapel Gardens.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.65).
